title: The comment-narration check passes a "round N" that names a rule
why: lint/check_comment_narration.py flags "round 3" and "after round 3" in a comment that states a rule, such as "a passing fix keeps the net value round 3 gave", which quotes decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 (net-value hold after round 3). note: Fix: a "round N" that names a rule or decision passes; a "round N" that tells history is still flagged.
